name: Silence Reading
description: Read the silences between sounds and learn what each one hides.

name: Hush Dominion
description: Wrap the user and every ally in reach in a hush that no hostile sense can pierce.

name: Breath Hold
description: Hold a dying ally's soul to the body through the last breath and into the next.

name: Echo Unravel
description: Unravel a deep soul curse from one ally thread by thread without harm.

name: Allseeing Dark
description: Make the darkest place as clear to the soul as a lit hall and show every soul in it.

name: Thought Harvest
description: Gather the surface thoughts of every soul in reach into one clear stream.

name: Peace Lend
description: Lend a deep peace to every ally so that fear cannot take hold of any of them.

name: Mind Quell
description: Quell the will of every foe in reach until each stands still and unthinking.

name: Nameless Ken
description: Read a soul down to the self beneath its name with a depth that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Mercy Wave
description: Send a wave of mercy through every ally to cleanse their souls and mend soul wounds with a strength that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Chorus Eternal
description: Bind all allies into an unending chorus that shares sense and strength with a power that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Knowing Total
description: Know every soul across a whole country at once down to each one's present will.

name: Beyond Silence
description: Hear the silence under all silence and so know every soul that has lived or lives or will live near the user.
